name: Iron Shirt (Combat)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Constitution 15, ki pool or Toughness

Benefit(s): While using iron shirt style the practitioner gains DR 1/- + 1 per additional iron shirt style feat the practitioner possesses. While employing iron shirt style your base movement speed and any forced movement you receive is reduced by 10 ft.
